item.title: Trump directs federal government to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America
item.description: President Trump signed an executive order on Thursday directing the federal government to rename Lake Ontario amid an escalating trade dispute with Canada .

item.title: Ratko Mladic, ex-Bosnian Serb warlord who oversaw atrocities, has died at 84
item.description: Ratko Mladic was one of the most notorious figures of a war that killed over 100,000 people in the 1990s. He commanded his troops to "scorch the brains" of the Bosnian Muslims and boasted of being a "Serbian God."
item.content:encoded:
Ratko Mladic was one of the most notorious figures of a war that killed over 100,000 people in the 1990s. He commanded his troops to "scorch the brains" of the Bosnian Muslims and boasted of being a "Serbian God."

(Image credit: Peter Dejong)

item.title: The real cause of most wildfires? People
item.description: More than three quarters of all wildfires in the U.S. are caused by human behavior including accidents, negligence and arson.

item.title: Meta reaches $17B settlement. And, nuclear regulator to abandon radiation safety rule

item.title: NDAs are hiding data center deals, drawing ire from locals — and attention from lawmakers
item.description: Nondisclosure agreements covered up negotiations between a tech company and several local and state officials, surprising local residents. It's a tactic used around the country in data center deals.

item.title: Jon Ossoff, usually a head down senator, has found a formula to excite Democrats
item.description: Ossoff should be among the most vulnerable Senate incumbents this year. Instead, the Georgia Democrat has opened a steady lead in polls and is increasingly seen as a potential 2028 contender.
